name: Evidence Interaction Lifecycle
ascii:
Legend: `[D]` = data structure, `(O)` = operation, `[S]` = state.

                         EVIDENCE INTERACTION LIFECYCLE

 [D] DiagramView / AsciiSelectionGrid visual element
       |
       | pointer / mapped-span interaction
       v
 (O) Mapped ASCII hinge
     src/components/AsciiSelectionGrid.tsx:AsciiSelectionGrid
       |
       | onReveal(`mapping`), map id, representation-element id
       v
 [D] Visual-to-Evidence map
     src/domain.ts:DiagramCodeEntityMapRecord
       | artifact + exact ASCII SHA-256 revision
       | `mapping` = CodeEntity id + range index + line / columns
       v
 (O) RepresentationIndex resolver
     src/representationIndex.ts:spatialEvidenceResolver
       |
       +---- caller-chosen index / supported command kinds ---->
       |      [D] No universal Evidence navigation
       |          SpatialEvidenceResolver / ElementCommandContribution
       |          current tree/diagram may reveal Evidence;
       |          no Evidence-to-all-Representations action
       |
       v
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                    EVIDENCE / USER-INTERACTION HINGE                         |
| [D] Evidence -> CodeEntity compatibility                                    |
|     src/domainProfile.ts:EvidenceSchema                                      |
|     persisted CodeEntityRecord -> domain-neutral EvidenceEntity              |
|     identity + description + category + exact source-range anchors           |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
       |
       | user selects entity + exact range, or accepts mapped reveal
       v
 (O) Inspect Evidence and reveal source
     src/components/CodeEntitiesPanel.tsx:CodeEntitiesPanel
       |
       v
 [D] Authoritative corpus anchors
     src/domain.ts:SourceRange / CodeEntityRecord
     `SourceRange` = path + inclusive lines + symbol + immutable snapshot
       |
       v
 AUTHORITATIVE CORPUS SOURCE
 src/domainProfile.ts:CorpusProvider line reads; foreign source uses captured snapshot

 MAPPED / SELECTED EVIDENCE BRANCHES

 Visual drag rectangle
       |
       v
 (O) Rectangle -> RefBufferContext
     src/components/DiagramView.tsx:completeSelection
     normalize -> intersect mapped spans -> range-aware `ReferenceIdentity` -> dedupe
       |
       v
 (O) Selected Evidence -> call-graph focus
     src/callGraphFocus.ts:createCallGraphFocusRequest
     provenance + active source Diagram + buffered selection -> focused context tab

 Mapped or selected Evidence
       +---- toggle / reveal ----> [S] Persistent Evidence highlights
       |                               src/highlights.ts:HighlightRecordV2
       |                               revision + element + EvidenceElementLink + excerpt
       |
       +---- associate files ----> (O) Evidence file associations
                                       src/fileTree.ts:diagramFileFilter
                                       local normalized paths + range indexes;
                                       missing / foreign / invalid anchors stay separate
